VCamdroid Windows companion
===========================

1. Unzip this folder somewhere permanent (for example Documents\VCamdroid).
2. For USB: install Apple Devices (or iTunes) from the Microsoft Store and open it once.
3. On the iPhone, open VCamdroid, tap OBS Studio, and leave that screen in front.
4. Run VCamPanel.exe. Click Refresh, select the phone, then Connect.
5. In OBS, add a VCamdroid or DroidCam OBS source.
   - USB: IP 127.0.0.1, port 4747
   - Wi-Fi: use the address shown in VCamPanel (Copy button)

WebView2 Runtime is required (current Windows 11 already has it):
https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/

usbmux_forward.exe is optional. You do not need it when VCamPanel is connected over USB.

Full guide: https://github.com/ahoin001/vcam-iphone
